title: SAP Sales Returns and Claims Control Plane

meta.summary: Deep reverse-logistics and customer-claims model separating physical receipt, ownership, inspection, disposition and compensation.

memory_rule: Goods received is not the same as goods owned, and goods owned is not the same as customer refunded.

ownership_states.meaning: Customer still has the product or it is returning; no company stock yet.
Product is physically received while ownership/refund can remain undecided; typical full-return inspection buffer.
Ownership transferred to the company while final disposition can still be pending.
Product reaches unrestricted, scrap, specified stock or another owned destination.
Product leaves toward supplier, customer, other plant or repair according to the follow-up branch.

follow_up_map.title: Receive into Plant
follow_up_map.creates: returns delivery / goods receipt; final decision later

follow_up_map.title: Immediately Move to Free Available Stock
follow_up_map.creates: inspection + returns delivery + GR to unrestricted stock

follow_up_map.title: Immediately Move to Scrap
follow_up_map.creates: GR to returns stock + scrap movement

follow_up_map.title: Ship to Supplier
follow_up_map.creates: returns purchase order after company receipt/inspection

follow_up_map.title: Direct Shipment to Supplier
follow_up_map.creates: returns purchase order; customer ships directly to supplier

follow_up_map.title: Inspection at Customer Site
follow_up_map.creates: no final logistics document; next follow-up must be selected

follow_up_map.title: Transfer to Specified Stock
follow_up_map.creates: material posting to configured target stock

follow_up_map.title: Goods Receipt Quantity Correction
follow_up_map.creates: outbound delivery without order reference + GI for missing quantity

refund_controls.title: Start Approved Refund
refund_controls.replacement: create subsequent delivery free of charge

refund_controls.title: Immediate
refund_controls.credit: create credit memo immediately; product must be marked received
refund_controls.replacement: create replacement order, delivery and GI immediately

process_records.one_sentence: Physical receipt, ownership, inspection/disposition and customer compensation are separate controls.
trace: reference sales order/billing document + return reason

failure_proofs.trace: refund control → valuation suspension → follow-up ownership signal → stock state
inspection split → confirmed follow-up → supplier/plant/storage/service prerequisites → generated document
split quantity → refund determination level → refund code → credit/replacement quantity
receiving stock → valuation → unrestricted transfer → ATP/MRP visibility
0026 → no-refund control → serial/equipment → Service integration → repair object

assert: non-valuated returns stock before ownership decision

tests.case: replacement product differs from returned product

process_records.one_sentence: Simple receipt to valuated stock plus credit; no inspection-driven disposition engine.
process_records.boundary: Use ARM when inspection, supplier/plant forwarding, repair or flexible refund control is required.

process_records.one_sentence: Goods stay with customer; reduce the receivable through a governed credit request.
process_records.key_failure: Historical claim accidentally uses wrong copied/redetermined pricing context.

process_records.one_sentence: Goods do not move; increase the receivable through a governed debit request.
Correct the invoice by preserving original and corrected values as a paired-item delta.
Existing invoice is explicitly too low; calculate and bill the increase delta.
Resolve shortage or damage with another goods shipment instead of money.

integration_boundaries.owns: warehouse execution and optional inspection/simple follow-up

integration_boundaries.sales_owns: decision to route 0005/0007 and customer-side trace

integration_boundaries.notes: Customer Return A2X V4 supports standard CBAR processing; Returns Inspection A2X V4 supports inspection data and split items; API feature coverage differs by interface version.
